editorial:
Imagine being told you can't do something you love because of how you were born. That is exactly what you get with this heartwarming story about Anthony Robles. You will meet a young man who refuses to let the fact that he was born without one leg stop him from wrestling. With his mom Judy by his side and some great coaches pushing him, you get to watch him fight for a spot on the Arizona State team. It is the kind of movie that makes you want to get off the couch and tackle your own goals, focusing on family bonds and pure grit.

The acting is great and the wrestling matches feel real and intense. While some parts of the story feel a bit predictable, the emotional payoff makes it worth your time. You will probably find yourself cheering out loud during the big tournament scenes. It is a perfect pick for a family movie night.
endingExplained: Everything leads up to the big NCAA Championship. You see Anthony face his toughest opponents and push his body to the absolute limit. In the final match, he uses his unique style and strength to win the national title. The movie wraps up by showing that his hard work paid off. He proves to the world that his disability was not a weakness, ending on a high note of victory and pride.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories about overcoming the odds.
